name: mindspeed-scan-issue-agent
description: Cross-repository GitCode Issue triage with safe local credential setup, guarded drafts, and an integrated web Observatory.

interface.shortDescription: Analyze Issues across selected GitCode repositories
interface.longDescription: Scans user-selected GitCode repositories, creates guarded drafts, and installs the MindSpeed Issue Observatory with a local settings center for secure credentials and repository policy.
defaultPrompt: Analyze an Issue in a GitCode repository I name without posting.
Preview pending Issues after checking whether a read token is configured.
Create code-grounded shadow drafts for selected Issues.
Open the full Issue visualization website for the repository I already selected.
